title: Know your customer, set up your kit, plan with numbers
course_title: Digital Marketing Fundamentals for Small Businesses

say: Know your customer, set up your kit, and plan with numbers.
This is the video for module one of Digital Marketing Fundamentals: customers, channels and a plan.
Marketing is everything you do to help the right people discover you, trust you, buy and come back. The funnel maps that journey.
Awareness is when someone sees your post or your shop on Google Maps for the first time.
Consideration is when she looks at your catalog, reads reviews and asks the price on WhatsApp.
Conversion is when she pays.
Loyalty is when she buys again and tells her friends.
When sales are low, the funnel shows where. Many views but no messages? Perhaps your price is hidden. Many messages but few payments? Perhaps you reply too slowly.
Amaka sells small chops in Port Harcourt, and compares two ways to promote one weekend. These prices are illustrative and approximate.
Option A. Print 500 flyers for about 15,000 naira, and pay a helper about 5,000 to share them.
That is about 20,000 naira to reach 500 people. Per 1,000 people, that is about 40,000 naira.
The flyers brought 3 orders. She knew, because she asked each caller where they heard of her.
Option B. An ad for about 10,000 naira reached 8,000 people, about 1,250 naira per 1,000 people, and brought 5 orders.
So she keeps a few flyers for her street, and moves most of her budget to the ad. But remember, reach is not sales. Follow the funnel down to orders before you decide.
My product is for everybody is a common mistake. Ads charge for every view, and a message for everyone speaks to no one.
Bisi cooks meal packs in Abuja. She looked at her last 30 orders and talked to six regular customers.

say: I want more customers is a wish, not a goal. Bisi's goal is 40 meal-pack orders in March. Followers and likes do not pay rent, so aim at orders.

cards.d: A SMART goal: specific, measurable, achievable, relevant and time-bound.
20 of every 100 people who chat with Bisi order. 40 orders need 200 chats.
2 of every 100 who see her posts send a message. 200 chats need 10,000 people.

say: Her notebook shows 20 of every 100 people who chat with her order. That is a 20% conversion rate. So 40 orders need 200 chats.

say: And 2 of every 100 people who see her posts send a message. So 200 chats need 10,000 people reached.
If she replies faster and lifts her rate to 25%, she needs only 160 chats. Fixing the bottom of the funnel is often cheaper than buying reach.

say: To remember. Use owned, earned and paid media together. Pick one specific customer. Build your starter kit before ads. Set goals on orders, not likes.
And in your budget, spend only what you can afford to lose while you learn.
